status: Frozen CVTM-core (docs/11 section 11.6) and the shared cache of the docs/13 A3 and A4 lanes. Validation split only; the test split is never loaded. The core is deterministic given the data (no seed). Validation rows are logged from the frozen implementation; no threshold is decided by this run except the pipeline checks listed under reference.
docs: docs/11 sections 11.2 to 11.6; docs/12 F19 and F20 (b) residues via the docs/11 section 3 mix64, (c) pooled EM of src/tmlm/cvtm/mixture.py, (d) pruning estimator; docs/13 A3 and A4 (H' roles)

params.kn: KNModel(5, 8000, discount_mode='modified', pad=True, unk_interp=True) fitted by tmlm.cvtm.kn_gpu.fit_kn (array-identical to KNModel.fit); suffix clauses tmlm.cvtm.suffix.SuffixClauses.from_kn; P_KN(gold) = exp of the float64 vote sum (docs/11 11.2 reference form), checked against KNModel.prob at every position
params.fit_documents: H = training documents i with mix64(i XOR 0xC0FFEE) mod 100 == 0 (304 documents, 1,397,702 tokens, asserted)
params.held_out_documents: H' = residues {0, 1, 2}: 0 core_em, 1 t2_train, 2 selection (docs/13 A4)

combination.pooled_weights: plain EM of tmlm.cvtm.mixture (docs/12 F20 c)

cache_groups.hprime: every position of the H' documents; KN top-64 and core arrays over the KN without H' with the frozen EM weights
cache_groups.validation: every position of the validation split; KN top-64 of the KN on all documents and the frozen core

rows: kn5_D0 (components S, D0: the H8.4 comparator)

bootstrap.statistic: per resample: sum of bits / sum of UTF-8 bytes of the drawn documents
bootstrap.label: derived

reference.pipeline_checks: the KNModel path equals 1.3501314033898424 exactly; the vote-form KN-5 row within 1e-9 of it; the CVTM-core within 1e-4 of 1.2408831796986637; vote form within 1e-9 of KNModel.prob in ln P at every position; k* equal to mixture.kn_gold_and_depth; streaming document features equal batch; EM objectives non-decreasing; every full-distribution row sums to one within 1e-9 and its gold entries equal the gold pass exactly; the saved core reloads with the same state hash and bit-identical validation log2 P; every KN file reloads with identical array hashes

compute.gpu_note: CuPy pool capped at 9 GiB during each KN fit (docs rule for the shared lock: under 10 GB); the suffix-link search of SuffixClauses.from_kn uses about 2 GB more at most
compute.dense_note: full-distribution passes in 3 forked processes over disjoint position ranges; every per-row result is independent of the split
compute.memory_rule: before each KN fit: memory.current + 30 GiB < 0.80 memory.max, else wait (poll 2 minutes); mem_guard at its default limit

launch: scripts/gpu_run.sh shared -- scripts/cpu_slot.sh 3 -- nice -n 10 .venv-tm/bin/python scripts/mem_guard.py -- scripts/run_logged.py --name cvtm_cache_build --config experiments/cvtm/configs/cvtm_cache_build.json -- .venv-tm/bin/python -u experiments/cvtm_lm.py --config experiments/cvtm/configs/cvtm_cache_build.json
